# sqlpipe v2.0

This release changes the user API, adds an incremental mode, and makes Parquet writes faster.

## Breaking change

CAUTION: Update your clients before you upgrade to v2.0. The `name` field of `/v2/users` is now two fields: `first_name` and `last_name`. Clients that still read `name` will fail. Map `first_name` and `last_name` in every client that uses this endpoint. Then deploy the clients. Then upgrade sqlpipe. If you cannot update the clients first, do not upgrade.

## New flag

You can use the `--incremental` flag to process only new rows. sqlpipe skips rows that it already wrote. This flag helps with repeated exports of large tables.

## Performance

Parquet writes are 40% faster than in v1. Large exports finish in less time. No configuration change is necessary for this gain.
